AMAZABURI
Izaburi y’112. Ugushemeza Imana ibungabunga abatobato.
Umusi wa Pentekoti, aleluya,
wasanze abatumwa bose bakoraniye hamwe. Aleluya!
Bantu b’Umukama, nimuninahaze Umukama,
muninahaze izina ry’Umukama!
Izina ry’Umukama nirishimagizwe
ubu no mu myaka yose;
kuva mu buseruko gushika mu burengero,
izina ry’Umukama nirishemezwe.
Umukama ari hejuru y’ibihugu vyose,
ubuninahazwa bwiwe buri hejuru y’amajuru.
Mbega, uwongana n’Umukama Imana yacu yova hehe, †
ko mbona yurira kuvyagira mu ngoro yiwe,
akururuka kuraba ibiri mw’ijuru no kw’isi?
Umukama akura mu musenyi abatagira amagara,
umukene akamukura mu mwavu;
kugira ngo amwicarike hamwe n’abakuru,

hamwe n’abakuru b’igihugu ciwe.
Intavyara ayiha kurondoka,
igahimbarwa mu nzu yuzuye ibibondo.
Umusi wa Pentekoti, aleluya,
wasanze abatumwa bose bakoraniye hamwe. Aleluya!
Izaburi y’146. Ugushemeza Imana itanga ubuzima
Babona haserutse imbeya zimeze nk’iz’umuriro.
Bose rero buzura Mutima. Aleluya!
Shemeze Umukama:
birahimbaye kuririmbira Imana yacu,
biraryoshe kumushimagiza.
Umukama ni we yubaka Yeruzalemu,
akoraniriza hamwe abana b’Israyeli, bari bangajwe;
ni we akiza abo agatima gashegeshwe,
agakanda inguma zabo;
ni we aharura igitigiri c’inyenyeri,
imwimwe akayita izina ryayo.
Umukama Mushoboravyose ni agahambaye,
ubwenge bwiwe ntibugira ingero.
Umukama ahagarikira abatobato,
inkozi z’ikibi na zo akazicinyiriza hasi.
Muririmbire Umukama mumukengurukira,
mucurarangire Imana yacu mu murya w’inanga.
Ijuru ni we arikwiza ibicu,
akaronderera imvura isi;
ni we ameza ubwatsi ku mitumba,
akaronderera imirima abantu;
ni we agaburira utwokurya ibitungwa,
be n’ivyana vy’ibikona nyene.

Ntiyishimira ubukomezi bw’ifarasi,
kandi ntiyizigira intege z’abantu.
Umukama ahimbarwa n’abamwubaha,
be n’abizera ikigongwe ciwe.
Babona haserutse imbeya zimeze nk’iz’umuriro.
Bose rero buzura Mutima. Aleluya!
Ururirimbo. Ivyahishuwe 15, 3-4.
Mutima yamûka kuri Data, aleluya,
azonshingira intahe. Aleluya!
Ivyo wagize ni agahambaye kandi ni akaroruhore,
Mukama, Mana Mushoboravyose.
Inzira zawe ni iz’ubutungane kandi ni iz’ukuri,
Mwami w’ibihugu vyose.
Ni nde yoreka kugutinya, Mukama?
Ni nde yoreka kuninahaza izina ryawe?
Ni wewe musa mweranda!
Ibihugu vyose iyo ziva zikagera
zizoza zigukubitire ibipfukamiro,
kuko amateka yawe yamenyekanye!
Mutima yamûka kuri Data, aleluya,
azonshingira intahe. Aleluya!

URURIRIMBO RWA BIKIRA MARIYA
Ingo, Mutima Mweranda, niwuzure imitima y’abakwemera, gira ko
urukundo bagufitiye rwomera muri bo nk’umuriro waka, wewe wakoranirije
mu bumwe bw’ukwemera abantu bavuga indimi zose zo kw’isi. Aleluya!
IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Nimuze dusabe Imana, Yo yungiye ubumwe abantu muri Kristu, mu
kubaha Mutima Mweranda, tuvuge tuti:
Mukama, rungika Mutima wawe.
Mukama w’ijuru n’isi, Wewe ushaka gukiza ibiremwa vyose ku
bw’Ipasika ya Kristu wawe,
- boneshereza abantu ku bw’ingabirano ya Mutima.
Wewe ukoraniriza mu bumwe bw’ukwemera abana bawe bashwiragiye,
- gira ko abemera bohuza umutima n’umushaha, ku bw’ibatisimu imwe
baronkera muri Mutima.
Wewe waduhaye ingabirano za Mutima wawe,
- duhe turonderere isi amahoro n’ubutungane.

Kubera ko Mutima wawe ari we agira vyose bishasha,
- nubere ubuhungiro abatobato, abarwaye ubabere urukiza, n’abantu
bose ubabere ubukiriro.
Wewe wazuye Umwana wawe ukamukura mu bapfuye ku bw’ububasha
bwa Mutima,
- nuhe imibiri yacu ikwiye gupfa ubuzima budahera.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…
IGISABISHO
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi wamaho, warashatse ko amabanga ya
Pasika aranguka hanyuma y’imisi mirongo itanu; ni co gituma
tugusavye rero ngo Mutima ushaka kurungika mu bantu bashwiragiye
kw’isi yose abakoranirize mu bumwe bw’ukwemera izina ryawe, umwe
wese aryemeze mu rurimi rwiwe.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Umuhezagiro.
MU GITONDO
Mukama, mfatanura umunwa
Ururimi rwanje ruheze ruguhaye.

23 (24)
Aleluya! Ijuru n’isi vyuzuye Mutima w’Umukama: nimuze dusenge Imana.

vyose akongera akatwibutsa ivyo watubwiye vyose,

ngo agushingire intahe,

AMAZABURI
Izaburi y’110. Imana irashemezwa mu bikorwa vyayo
Umukama yuzuye urukundo rw’igishika n’impuhwe,
yaragaburiye abamwemera. Yarabasigaranye icibutso c’ibikorwa
vyiwe vy’agatangaza.
Ndaninahaza Umukama n’umutima wanje wose,
mu gihari c’aberanda no mw’ikoraniro ryabo.
Ibikorwa vy’Umukama birahambaye,
birabereye kurimburwa n’ababikunda.
Ivyo yakoze birateye iteka n’itungane,
ubutungane bwiwe buzokwamaho.
Yaradusigaranye icibukirizo c’ivyiza yagize,
eka bane Umukama ni Nyenimbabazi n’ikigongwe.
Aragaburira abamwubaha bose;
akibuka indagano ziwe ubudahengeshanya.
Yarerekanye mu bantu biwe
ko ibikorwa vyiwe ari akagoye,
mu kubaha iragi ry’ibihugu vyose.
Ibikorwa vyiwe ni vyo kuri n’ubutungane,
amateka yiwe yose ntatirimuka;
yayashinze ngo arambe imyaka yose,
akayarangura mu butungane no mu kuri.
Yararungikiye icungurwa abantu biwe, †
aragana indagano y’intahava;
izina ryiwe ni ryeranda kandi rirahambaye.

Intango y’ubwitonzi ni ukwubaha Imana, †
incabwenge ni barya babigira;
bakwiye ikaze imyaka yose.
Umukama yuzuye urukundo rw’igishika n’impuhwe,
yaragaburiye abamwemera. Yarabasigaranye icibutso c’ibikorwa
vyiwe vy’agatangaza.

ni we ayonza urubura nk’ubwoya bw’intama,
agakunkumura amarekano y’amabi nk’umunyota.
Ni we aca amasare y’urubura ubunywenywe,
urukanya rwayo ni nde yorukira?
Avuga rimwe, maze rugaca rushonga,
yarungika umuyaga wiwe, amazi agatemba.
Ni we yamenyesheje Yakobo ijambo ryiwe,
agashikiriza Israyeli amabwirizwa yiwe n’ingingo ziwe.
Nta kindi gihugu na kimwe yagiriye ben’uko,
nta kindi gihugu na kimwe camenye ingingo ziwe.
Umukama azana amahoro muri Ekleziya yiwe
akongera akayihagisha umukate w’ingano.

Izaburi y’109. Kristu ni we Mwami n’Umusaserdoti
Kubera uguhwahuka kw’umutwaro wawe, Mukama,
nuganze no hagati mu bansi bawe.
Umukama yabariye Umukama wanje, ati:
«Niwicare iburyo bwanje,
gushika aho nzogira abansi bawe irambirizo.»
Uhangamye muri Siyoni azokwiza ubwami bwawe:
ganza no ku bansi bawe.
Wavukanye ingoma ku misozi myeranda,
umutwenzi utarakika narakwibarutse.
Umukama yarabiraganye kandi ntazokwisubirako,
ati: «Uzokwama uri umusaserdoti w’intahava,
nk’umwami Melekisedeki.»
Umukama ahagaze iburyo bwawe,
acuranguza abami ku musi w’ishavu ryiwe.
Ku rugendo azonywa amazi avuye mw’isôko,
ni co gituma azoraramura umutwe.
Kubera uguhwahuka kw’umutwaro wawe, Mukama,
nuganze no hagati mu bansi bawe.
Izaburi y’110. Imana irashemezwa mu bikorwa vyayo
Umukama yuzuye igishika n’impuhwe,
abamwemera yarabahaye imfungurwa.
Ndaninahaza Umukama n’umutima wanje wose,
mu gihari c’aberanda no mw’ikoraniro ryabo.
Ibikorwa vy’Umukama birahambaye,
birabereye kurimburwa n’ababikunda.
Ivyo yakoze birateye iteka n’itungane,

ubutungane bwiwe buzokwamaho.
Yaradusigaranye icibukirizo c’ivyiza yagize,
eka bane Umukama ni Nyenimbabazi n’ikigongwe.
Aragaburira abamwubaha bose;
akibuka indagano ziwe ubudahengeshanya.
Yarerekanye mu bantu biwe
ko ibikorwa vyiwe ari akagoye,
mu kubaha iragi ry’ibihugu vyose.
Ibikorwa vyiwe ni vyo kuri n’ubutungane,
amateka yiwe yose ntatirimuka;
yayashinze ngo arambe imyaka yose,
akayarangura mu butungane no mu kuri.
Yararungikiye icungurwa abantu biwe, †
aragana indagano y’intahava;
izina ryiwe ni ryeranda kandi rirahambaye.
Intango y’ubwitonzi ni ukwubaha Imana, †
incabwenge ni barya babigira;
bakwiye ikaze imyaka yose.
Umukama yuzuye igishika n’impuhwe,
abamwemera yarabahaye imfungurwa.
Ururirimbo. Abanyafilipi 2, 6-11. Kristu ni we Musavyi w’Imana
Ng’uwu Umwagazi w’Imana,
ng’uwu uwukura igicumuro c’isi.
Kristu Kristu Yezu, n’aho yamanye kamere k’Imana,
ntiyigeze yishira hejuru
ngo ni uko ari Imana.
Ariko yigize ubusa,
mu gusangira kamere y’abasuku,
mu kwigira umuntu asa n’abandi.

Yigenjeje nk’umuntu asanzwe,
yicisha bugufi, aragamburuka
gushika ku rupfu, no ku rupfu rwo ku musaraba.
Ni co catumye Imana imushira hejuru ya vyose,
imwita Izina nyaryo,
izina rirengeye amazina yose.
Kugira ngo kw’izina rya Yezu
bose bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi,
mw’ijuru, kw’isi no mu nyenga,
Kandi ururimi rwose ruvuge ruti:
«Yezu Kristu ni we Mukama,
ngo Se aninahazwe!»
Ng’uwu Umwagazi w’Imana,
ng’uwu uwukura igicumuro c’isi.

AMAZABURI
Izaburi y’140. Igisabisho c’umurushwa yitura Imana
Igisabisho canje nikiduge imbere yawe, nk’umwotsi w’isenga;
ibiganza nkiriza na vyo nk’ishikanwa ryo ku mugoroba.

Mukama, ndagutakambiye tebuka uze aho ndi;
untege ugutwi, aho ndiko ndagutakambira.
Igisabisho canje nikiduge imbere yawe
nk’umwotsi w’isenga;
ibiganza nkiriza na vyo
nk’ishikanwa ryo ku mugoroba.
Mukama, kingira umunwa wanje,
kandi ntabara undindire ururimi.
Ntabara, umutima wanje woye gukurikira akabi,
sinje mu vyo gukora akabi hamwe n’abanyavyaha.
Ego cane, sinshaka kuryoherwa n’ibibaryohera; †
ni ko umweranda nankubite bivuye ku bugenzi, nampanure;
mugabo ababisha bo ntihagire ico nsangira na bo:
ivyaha vyabo nzokwama ndabirwanya
mu kuguma ndagusaba.
Abacamanza babo bazotembagarizwa mu manga,
niho rero bazohava bumviriza
yuko amajambo yanje aryoshe.
Nk’uko ibuye risābá rigaseruka,
ni ko amagufa yabo azosabagira iruhande y’icobo.

ni Wewe mahungiro yanje,
ntumpebe ngo mbe ruhebwa!

n’ivyo inkozi z’ikibi zanteze.

ibiganza nkiriza na vyo nk’ishikanwa ryo ku mugoroba.
Izaburi y’141. Igisabisho c’umurushwa yitura Imana
Umukama ni we nzotorana kw’isi y’abazima.

Ndataka ntakambira Umukama,
ndataka ntabaza Umukama:
ndareka amarira akisuka imbere yiwe,
nkabogoreza ayo ngowe imbere yiwe.
Magingo aya ata ho ngihumekera,
Weho urazi inzira nocamwo;
mu nzira ncamwo banteze imitego,
nta n’umwe ababaye ubuzima bwanje.
Itegereze iburyo bwanje urabe:
nta n’umwe ampa nirwere,
mbuze aho mpungira,
nta n’umwe ababaye ubuzima bwanje.
Nagutakambiye, Mukama †
ngira nti: «Ni Wewe mirukiro yanje,
ni Wewe nzotorana kw’isi y’abazima».
Zirikana ko nkuborogeye,
amarushwa arandembeje rwose;
nkiza abampama,
kuko bandusha inguvu.
Kura umutima wanje mw’ibohero,
mbonereho guhaya izina ryawe;
niho mbere n’intungane zizomvyagira iruhande,
mu gihe uzoba wanteye iteka.
Umukama ni we nzotorana kw’isi y’abazima.

Kristu Yezu, n’aho yamanye kamere k’Imana,
ntiyigeze yishira hejuru

ngo ni uko ari Imana.
Ariko yigize ubusa,
mu gusangira kamere y’abasuku,
mu kwigira umuntu asa n’abandi.
Yigenjeje nk’umuntu asanzwe,
yicisha bugufi, aragamburuka
gushika ku rupfu, no ku rupfu rwo ku musaraba.
Ni co catumye Imana imushira hejuru ya vyose,
imwita izina nyaryo,
izina rirengeye amazina yose.
Kugira ngo kw’izina rya Yezu
bose bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi,
mw’ijuru, kw’isi no mu nyenga,
Kandi ururimi rwose ruvuge ruti:
«Yezu Kristu ni we Mukama,
ngo Se aninahazwe!»
Kristu yarapfuye ngo atwishurire ibicumuro,
Kristu yarazutse ngo atuzanire ubuzima.

Ku vyerekeye amajambo y’igifaransa «louer, louange, glorifier, gloire». Ndayashira
mu kirundi gute? Iyo turi mu Nkuka y’imisa, twama tuvuga tuti: Nous te louons =
turaguhaya, nous te bénissons = turakuyaga, nous t’adorons = turagusenga, nous te
glorifions = turakuninahaza. Mfatiye aho, nagiye ndakoresha ijambo «kuninahaza»
n’ijambo «ubuninahazwa» aho nabonye bagize «glorifier» canke «rendre gloire»,
n’ijambo «ubuninahazwa» aho nabonye banditse «gloire». Ahandi hose nakoresheje
amavuga «gushemeza, gushimagiza, guhaya, guhayagiza, kuyaga» n’amazina avuye
muri ayo.

superexaltate eum in saecula», kugira ngo ntituzosubire kwirirwa turasubira
kugihindura. Nayo ubundi, mu gifaransa murabona ko atari uko kivuga.

Izaburi ya 50. Igisabisho c’umucumuzi asaba ikigongwe
Ku bw’ikigongwe cawe kidakama, Mukama,
unzimanganirize akabi nakoze.
Ngirira ikigongwe, Mana yanje, kubera ubuntu bwawe,
ku bw’imbabazi zawe nyinshi, zimanganya ivyaha vyanje.
Nyuhagira umwanda wose mfise,
uheze uhanagure ibicumuro vyanje vyose.
Emwe simpakana ububegito bw’umutima wanje,
kuko ibicumuro vyanje vyose vyama binyagiriza.
Ni wewe musa nacumuyeko,
kandi nabikugiriye mu maso;
urubanza uciye ruraroranye,
ntaho wigera uca urwa ngondagonde.
Erega navukiye mu gicumuro,
na mawe yarakinsamanye;
weho wikundira intonganuke y’umushaha,
ni co gituma unshiramwo ubutungane ngo bunyure.
Ntotesha amazi y’umusarara, nce nkira umwanda wose,
unyuhagire nce ndusha inyange kwera de.
Nyumvisha ijambo ryompumuriza n’iry’urweze,
amagufa wari wajanjaguye ace yiyubura.
Ibicumuro vyanje vyose, vyikure mu maso,
n’ibibi vyanje vyose ubinzimanganirize.
Mukama, nshiramwo umushaha w’indanga,
ugushaka kwanje na kwo, ukuremeshe,
kwame kukwihambiriyeko.
Ntunshibure ngo nkuve mu maso,
ntera iteka ariko ungumizemwo ubwiza bwawe;
ndaba ryiza nka kera mpimbarwe,

kandi ndokoza ugushaka gutegera, sinzokwiyonkore.

abacumuye baheze bakugarukeko.

mbashe gushemeza ubuninahazwa bwawe.

iyo ndaguha imbagwa kw’iciru,
ntiyari kugushika ku nyota;
imperezwa ndagushikaniye, Mukama,
ni umutima waduhiwe n’ibicumuro nakoze;
umushaha wigaye kandi wicishije bugufi,
ntuzowushiburira kure.
Ku bw’ubwiza bwawe, Mukama, hezagira Siyoni,
sanura impome za Yeruzalemu.
Ni ho rero uzokenguruka inkuka zitunganye,
ari zo mperezwa n’imbagwa,
ni ho uzoshikirizwa ibimasa kuri altari yawe.
Ku bw’ikigongwe cawe kidakama, Mukama,
unzimanganirize akabi nakoze.

ariko yaramuduhebeye.
Kristu yarababaye ku bwacu,
adusigarana akarorero
kugira ngo dukurikire inzira yatweretse.
Inguma ziwe ni zo zadukijije.
We nta gicumuro yakoze,
kandi nta bubeshi bwabonetse mu kanwa kiwe.
We yaratutswe ntiyabasubiza,
yarababajwe ntiyabahigira,
ariko yarituye wese uwumucira urutunganye.
We nyene ubwiwe yarikoreye ibicumuro vyacu
mu mubiri wiwe, abambwa ku giti,
kugira ngo dupfe ku gicumuro
tube bazima mu butungane.
Imana ntiyimanye Umwana wayo,
ariko yaramuduhebeye.

AMAZABURI
Izaburi ya 44. Akavyino ko guhaya Umwami
I
Imvugo yawe irakuranga ubutore,
Umukama yaguhezagiye ubutacisubirako.
Agakuru keza kambakuye umutima, †
ngira ngo mvuge umwami yumvirize utwo nahinguye,
ururimi rwanje ni nk’ikaramu mu minwe y’umwanditsi w’umuhinga.
Uri indanga nyandanga mu bana b’abantu bose, †
imvugo yawe maze ikakuranga ubutore,
ni co gituma Imana yaguhezagiye ubutacisubirako.
Nuhagatire inkota yawe, wa muhisi we; †
mu mwakaka w’ubutore bwawe, wurire igitwazi cawe,
ugira ugenda kurwanira ukuri, urukundo n’ubutungane.

Banga umuheto, maze ububasha bwawe bube akarangabwami; †
aho umwampi wawe uciye, hasigare imihindigiti,
na bo abansi b’umwami batungûke umutima.
Ingoma yawe, Mukama, ntizokwigera itirimuka; †
icishimikizo cawe ni ic’ubutungane;
urakunda ubutungane ukazirana n’akabi.
Ni co gituma Imana, Umukama wawe, yagutoye mu bandi, †
akagusiga amavuta ateye urweze;
ivyambarwa vyawe na vyo bimota imira n’ibimoga neza.
Bagucurarangira inanga mu ngoro zisharije n’isenga; †
mu ncoreke zawe, harimwo abigeme b’abami,
iburyo bwawe, havyagiye umwamikazi yambaye inzahabu zavuye muri
Ofiri.
Imvugo yawe irakuranga ubutore,
Umukama yaguhezagiye ubutacisubirako.
II
Barahiriwe abatumire mu bugeni bw’Umwagazi.
Nyumviriza mwananje, itegereze kandi untege ugutwi, †
ibagira igihugu c’amavukiro yawe n’inzu ya so,
umwami azoheza yipfuze ubutore bwawe
Ng’uwu Umukama wawe: kubita ibipfukamiro imbere yiwe! †
Intara ya Tiri izokuzanira ishikanwa unezerwe,
ibihugu birusha ibindi gutunga bigushikanire amashikanwa y’inzahabu.
Umwigeme w’umwami bamushikanye i bwami †
yambaye ibisayangana bisharijwe n’inzahabu,
bamujana ikare, incoreke zamugenewe zikamukurikira.
Bose baje iwawe: †
binjiranye urweze n’akanyamuneza
mu ngoro i bwami.

Abana bawe bazosubira mu kirenge c’abasokuru,
uzobagira benintara n’ingoma.
Izina ryawe nzorigira rurangiranwa imyaka yose,
ibihugu vyose bizokuninahaza ubutazohera.
Barahiriwe abatumire mu bugeni bw’Umwagazi.

Ururirimbo. 1 Petero 2, 21-24. Kristu ni Umukiza

kugira ngo dukurikire inzira yatweretse.

- no kugenzwa n’urukundo rwawe.
Ibuka abihebeye benewabo ngo babakorere batitangiriye itama,
- kugira ngo ntihagire aho batezura imyitwarariko yabo, n’aho
bitogenda nk’uko bashaka.
Muremyi wa bose na vyose, Umwana wawe yigize umuntu yarashatse
kuba umukozi mu bandi bantu,
- ibuka abategerezwa gukenura n’ukubira akuya ngo bironkere
ivyobatunga.
Girira ikigongwe benewacu bapfuye,
- ntubahebere ububasha bwa shetani.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…

n’ingene yaruhijwe:
ingene yarahiye Umukama,
n’indagano yagiriye Umushoboravyose wa Yakobo.
«Sinzokwigera ninjira mu ngoro yanje,
sinzokwurira uburiri ngo nduhuke,
itiro ntirizongera ku maso,
icibagiwe co n’ukugoheka,
ntamaze kuronka aho Umukama avyagira,
ntatanagiye ingoro Umushoboravyose wa Yakobo.»
Sinzi abagize ngo iyo ngoro ishinzwe i Efurata,
ngo twayisanze mw’itaba ry’ikibira c’i Yahari.
Ingo twinjire aho avyagiye,
dukubite ibipfukamiro imbere y’aho ahangamye.

Wewe ubwawe n’isandugu y’ububasha bwawe.

nayo abantu bawe nibishongorane akanyamuneza.

ntuhinde uwo wimitse.
Umukama yaritoreye Yeruzalemu, ngo imubere ingoro.
II
Abasavyi bawe bishongorana akanyamuneza,
Mukama, mu gihe binjira aho uvyagiye.

Umukama yararahiye Dawudi indahiro y’ukuri,
kandi ntazokwirahuruza,
ati: «Uwuzokwamuka mu bura bwawe,
ni we nzoshira ku ngoma yawe.
Abana bawe nibagumya ivyo twasezeranye,
nibakora amategeko nabahaye,
abana babo na bo nyene bazoja ku ngoma yawe,
imyaka n’imyaka.»
Erega, Umukama ni We yitoreye Siyoni,
ni ho yagomba ngo bahamwubakire ingoro:
«Aho ni ho ngiye kuvyagira imyaka yose,
ni ho nzoba kuko nahagomwe.
Abeza baho nzobahundako umugisha,
aboro baho nzobagwiriza ivyokurya;
abasavyi baho na bo bazokwishongorana
akanyamuneza.
Niho nzobakomereza ubutwari bwa Dawudi,
niho nzotegurira urumuri uwo nitoreye;
nzomaramaza abansi biwe,
urugori rw’ubwami na rwo rusayangane
ku ruhanga rwiwe.»
Abasavyi bawe bishongorana akanyamuneza,
Mukama, mu gihe binjira aho uvyagiye.

- gira vyose bishasha ku bw’ububasha bwa Mutima wawe.
Dufashe dukanure uyu musi, twebwe n’abo tuvukana
- kugira ngo tubone ivyiza vy’agatangaza utugirira.
Wewe uduhamagarira uyu musi gukorera amabanga yawe meranda,
- tugire abakozi b’inema yawe dukorere benewacu.

Mukama, uranyitegereza kandi uranzi, †
ndicara ukabimenya, nahaguruka ukabimenya,
akari mu mutima wanje ukamenya ukiri kure;
ngendagenda canke ndyamye, umpozako ijisho,
inzira ncamwo zose ni Wewe uzizi.
Jewe rero sindagera kuvuga,
ariko Weho Mukama, imvugo yanje urayizi rwose;
urandōngōra kandi ukamperekeza,
iminwe yawe yama ingumije.
Bumenyi bundengeye,
uransumba sinshoboye kugutegera.

Nje hehe, kure yawe,
amaso yawe noyihisha hehe?
Nduga mw’ijuru nkagusangayo,
nururuka hasi, ni ho uri kandi.
Ndamuka mfashe akayira kare cane,
nkagenda kuba ku mpera z’intara,
na ho nyene ngendera mu minwe yawe,
ukuboko kwawe kukangumya.
Niho mvuga nti: «Ese umwijima wotwikira umurango
ugacika ijoro rimpisha»,
yamara kuri Wewe nta mwijima uriho,
ijoro rikumereye nk’umutaga.
Mukama, uranyitegereza kandi uranzi.
II
Ibikorwa vyawe ni ibitangaza, Mukama,
umutima wanje urabimenya.
Nkako, ni Wewe wampaye amagara,
ni Wewe wandemye mu nda ya mama.
Warangize agatangaza, ndabigukengurukiye,
ibikorwa vyawe ni agahore nk’akandi.
Na wo umutima wanje ni Wewe wowumenya neza,
n’umubiri wanje ntiwari uwuyobewe;
aho wampingura nari mu ngoma yawe,
mu gihe nari nkiri utwondo tw’ivu.
Ivyo ngira vyose amaso yawe yarabibona,
vyose vyari mu gitabu cawe;
imisi yanje yari yanditswe,
kandi yari iharuye ata n’umwe uraboneka.
Mukama, ivyiyumviro vyawe ni agatangaza,

igitigiri cavyo ntigiharurwa.
Nobiharura, vyosumba umusenyi mu bwinshi;
mba ngiheza, ngasanga turacari kumwe nawe.
Unyitegereze, Mukama, uheze umenye umutima wanje,
nusuzume ivyanje,
uheze umenye ivyiyumviro vyanje;
raba ko noba ndi mu nzira mbi,
uheze unjane mu nzira y’ubukiriro bwamaho.
Ibikorwa vyawe ni ibitangaza, Mukama,
umutima wanje urabimenya.

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Yohani 2, 3-6
Ng’iki ikizomenyesha ko tuzi Yezu Kristu: ni uko twozigama
amabwirizwa yiwe. Uwuvuga ati: «Ndamuzi», hanyuma ntazigame
amabwirizwa yiwe, ni umubeshi kandi ukuri ntikuri muri we. Ariko
uwuzigama ijambo ryiwe, ni ivy’ukuri, muri we ni ho urukundo
rw’Imana ruba urukundo rubushitse. Ico ni co kitumenyesha yuko turi
muri we. Uwibwira yuko aguma ari muri we, na we ategerezwa
kwigenza nk’uko Yezu yigenjeje.

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abanyaroma 8, 18-21
Jewe ndiyumvira ko amagorwa y’iki gihe turimwo ata ho ahuriye
n’ubuninahazwa tuzohishurirwa. Erega ibiremwa vyose birarindiranye
igishika cinshi igihe Imana izokwerekanira abana bayo. N’aho
ibiremwa vyose vyaguye mu buja bw’ibitagira mvura, si vyo
vyavyishakiye, vyavuye ku wabishize muri ubwo buja.45 Ariko
birizigiye yuko bizokira na vyo nyene bwa buja bw’ibibora, ngo
bishikire umwidegemvyo w’ubuninahazwa bw’abana b’Imana.
Muri Bibliya handitse ngo: «vyavuye ku Mana ibigaba» (Abanyaroma 8, 20).
Vyanyobeye gutahura ukuntu Imana yoba ari yo yabishize muri ubwo buja!

Izaburi y’8. Inganji y’Imana
Ewe Mukama, Mana yacu, †
izina ryawe ni agahambaye
kw’isi yose iyo iva ikagera.
Inganji yawe isumba ijuru,
mbere n’abana bakiri kw’ibere barayihaya,
ni yo ukoresha mu kurwanya abakwanka,
ngo utsinde abansi n’abamenja.
Mbe bane, uwitegereje ijuru waremye,
akabona ukwezi n’inyenyeri wamanitseyo,
ntiyoca n’ikanda ko wibuka umuntu,
ukitwararika umwana w’umuntu.
Hari hasigaye gato ukamuringaniza n’Imana,
umutera iteka, umutera ishaza;
wamuhaye kuganza ivyo waremye,
ugashira vyose munsi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Vyose, si intama, si impfizi,
mbere n’inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba,
si inyoni zo mu kirere, si ifi zo mu kiyaga,
mbere n’ivyoga vyose vyo mu mazi y’ibiyaga.
Ewe Mukama, Mana yacu, †
izina ryawe ni agahambaye
kw’isi yose iyo iva ikagera.

1. Turakuramutsa Mugabekazi, Nyina w’ikigongwe, wewe tugendako,

umutwereke wa musi tuzova muri ubu bucibwa, wewe
munyakigongwe, wewe mwiza, wewe Bikira utekereza, Mariya.
2. Turakwirukira uduhagarikire, Nyina mweranda w’Imana, mu bukene
bwacu, ntugaye ibisabisho vyacu, yamara udukize imisi yose, mu
magorwa yose. Wewe Mubikira muhimbazwa, nyaguhezagirwa. Amen!

Mu kilatini
Mu bindi bihe
1. Alma Redemptóris Mater,
quae pérvia caeli porta manes, et stella maris,
succúrre cadénti, súrgere qui curat, pópulo:
tu quae genuísti, natúra miránte,
tuum sanctum Genitórem,
Virgo prius ac postérius,
Gabriélis ab ore sumens illud Ave,
peccatórum miserére.
2. Ave, Regína caelórum,
ave, Dómina angelórum,
salve, radix, salve, porta,
ex qua mundo lux est orta.
Gaude, Virgo gloriósa,
super omnes speciósa;
vale, o valde decóra,
et pro nobis Christum exóra.
3. Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiae;
vita, dulcédo et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Evae.
Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes
in hac lacrimárum valle.
Eia ergo, advocáta nostra,
illos tuos misericórdes óculos
ad nos convérte.

Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
Ô Clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
4. Sub tuum praesídium confúgimus,
sancta Dei Génitrix;
nostras deprecatiónes ne despícias
in necessitátibus
sed a perículis cunctis líbera nos semper,
Virgo gloriósa et benedícta.
Mu gihe c’Ipasika
5. Regína caeli, laetáre, allelúia,
quia quem meruísti portáre, allelúia,
resurréxit sicut dixit, allelúia;
ora pro nobis Deum, allelúia.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Nibakirabire mu mashemezo rusangi y’Abatumwa
IGISABISHO
Mukama, Wewe warungitse Umutumwa Pawulo mweranda kwigisha
abantu bose iyo bava bakagera, turakuzamvye, mu kubandanya mu
nzira ija iwawe tukîgana uwo dushemeza uyu musi w’uguhinduka
kwiwe, nuduhe kuba ivyabona vy’ukuri kwawe mu maso y’abantu.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Umuhezagiro.
KU MUGOROBA
Mana, ingo untabare
Mukama, tebuka undwaneko.
Haninahazwe Data na Mwana na Mutima Mweranda
Nk’uko vyamye hambere hose, nibimere ko n’ubu n’ibihe vyose,
mu myaka n’imyaka. Amen. Aleluya!
AKAVYINO
Bazogashiraho. Canke baririmbe ururirimbo rwo guhayagiza umweranda
Pawulo.

AMAZABURI YO MU MASHEMEZO RUSANGI Y’ABATUMWA
(urup. 1108), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Nzoshima kwishimagiza canecane mu magara make yanje, kugira ngo
ubukomezi bwa Kristu bugerere muri jewe.
2. Uwutera nta co amaze n’uwuvomera nyene. Imana ni yo iri n’ico imaze yo
ikuza.
3. Kristu ni we buzima bwanje, kandi ugupfa vyombera akunguko: nta kindi
kininahaza ndetse umusaraba wa Yezu Kristu.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Abanyakorenti 15, 9-10
Jewe ndi uwa nyuma mu batumwa, sinkwiye no kwitwa umutumwa
kuko nahamye Ekleziya y’Imana. Ingabirano y’Imana ni yo yangize
uko ndi kandi ingabirano yayo nagiriwe ntiyampfuyeko ubusa, ahubwo
naratamye kubarusha bose, mbere si jewe, mugabo ni ingabirano
y’Imana iri kumwe nanje.
INYISHU
Umuco mwinshi urampwikiriye.
None ga Mukama, ngire iki?
Umuco mwinshi urampwikiriye
None ga Mukama, ngire iki?
Nya jwi rinyishura riti: Jewe ndi uwo uriko urahama
None ga Mukama ngire iki?
Uzombera icabona mu maso y’abantu.
Umuco mwinshi urampwikiriye.
None ga Mukama, ngire iki?

AMAZABURI YO KU MUGOROBA URONGORA UMUSI
MUKURU WA NOHELI (urup. 80), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Yozefu na Mariya bajanye umwana i Yeruzalemu kumuhereza Umukama.

Umukama, Umukiza w’igihugu ciwe!
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abahebereyi 10, 5-7
Mu kuza kw’isi, Kristu yavuze ati: «Imbagwa n’amashikanwa
ntiwabishatse, ariko wanteguriye umubiri. Inkuka n’imbagwa zo
kwishura ibicumuro ntiwazishimye. Niho rero navuga nti:
“Ndarengutse, kuko ivyanditswe mu kizingo c’igitabu birora kuri jewe,
kugira ngo nkore ivyo ushaka, Wewe Mana”.»

ndaje gukora ivyo ushaka.

AMAZABURI YO KU MUSI MUKURU WA NOHELI (urup. 87),
BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Mutima Mweranda yari yaramenyesheje Simeho ko atazosandaba
atarasanganira Uwasizwe n’Umukama.
2. Mu kwegurira umwana Umukama, bahereje inuma zibiri zikiri nto.
3. Amaso yanje yiboneye urukiza rwawe wateguriye ibihugu vyose.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abahebereyi 4, 15-16
Erega ntidufise Umuherezankuka mukuru adashobora kubabarana
natwe mu magara make yacu, kuko yagejejwe nkatwe muri vyose
kiretse igicumuro. Nitwegere rero ya ntebe y’umugisha ata co twinona,
kugira ngo tugirirwe ubuntu kandi turonke umugisha ngo bidufashe mu
gihe kibereye.
INYISHU

wateguriye ibihugu vyose.

ubu no mu myaka yose;

kugira ngo amwicarike hamwe n’abakuru,
hamwe n’abakuru b’igihugu ciwe.

Izaburi y’147. Amashemezo ya Yeruzalemu nshasha
Umukama azomuha ingoma ya se wiwe Dawudi,
ingoma yiwe ntizohera.
Yeruzalemu, igine Umukama,
nawe Siyoni, shemeza Imana yawe!
Ni we yashimangiye ibikingi vy’ibirimba vyawe,
akaguhezagirira abana bawe;
ni we atekanya imbibe zawe,
akaguhimbisha akanovera k’ingano.
Ni we arungika ijambo ryiwe kw’isi,
rigaheza rikagenda rinyaruka;
ni we ayonza urubura nk’ubwoya bw’intama,
agakunkumura amarekano y’amabi nk’umunyota.
Ni we aca amasare y’urubura ubunywenywe,
urukanya rwayo ni nde yorukira?
Avuga rimwe, maze rugaca rushonga,
yarungika umuyaga wiwe, amazi agatemba.
Ni we yamenyesheje Yakobo ijambo ryiwe,
agashikiriza Israyeli amabwirizwa yiwe n’ingingo ziwe.
Nta kindi gihugu na kimwe yagiriye ben’uko,
nta kindi gihugu na kimwe camenye ingingo ziwe.

Umukama azomuha ingoma ya se wiwe Dawudi,
ingoma yiwe ntizohera.
Ururirimbo. Abanyafilipi 2, 6-11. Kristu ni we Musavyi w’Imana
Jambo yamaho, umwe yavyarwa na Data ata myaka iravugwa,
uyu musi yigize ubusa kubera twebwe.
Kristu Yezu, n’aho yamanye kamere k’Imana,
ntiyigeze yishira hejuru
ngo ni uko ari Imana.
Ariko yigize ubusa,
mu gusangira kamere y’abasuku,
mu kwigira umuntu asa n’abandi.
Yigenjeje nk’umuntu asanzwe,
yicisha bugufi, aragamburuka
gushika ku rupfu, no ku rupfu rwo ku musaraba.
Ni co catumye Imana imushira hejuru ya vyose,
imwita izina nyaryo,
izina rirengeye amazina yose.
Kugira ngo kw’izina rya Yezu
bose bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi,
mw’ijuru, kw’isi no mu nyenga,
Kandi ururimi rwose ruvuge ruti:
«Yezu Kristu ni we Mukama,
ngo Se aninahazwe!»
Jambo yamaho, umwe yavyarwa na Data ata myaka iravugwa,
uyu musi yigize ubusa kubera twebwe.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Mu guhimbaza uyu musi mukuru w’Ibûrwa ry’Umukama, turasaba
twuzuye akanyamuneza, mu kuvuga tuti :
Bikira Mariya natubere mu ngoro.
Data Munyakigongwe, Mukama wuzuye igishika,
nk’uko wibutse umuntu wawe mutomuto,
- nuturabe ryiza wongere utugirire impuhwe.
Ese Inkuru nziza yokwakirwa mu mishaha y’abana bawe
nk’uko ubutumwa warungikanye Umumarayika bwakiriwe
na Mariya!
Ese abasavyi bawe borangura ishaka ryawe
nk’uko Mariya yagamburutse yumvise Ijambo ryawe!
Ese Bikira Mariya yogarukira abababaye, akarwanako abafise amagara
make, akaremesha abihebuye! Nafashe abasaserdoti n’abakwihebeye
kugumya ibanga; nasabire abemera bose!
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…
IGISABISHO
Mukama, warashatse ko Jambo wawe yigira umuntu w’ukuri mu gufata
kamere yacu y’abantu mu mbanyi ya Bikira Mariya; turakuzamvye
rero, nk’uko twemeye Umucunguzi wacu ko ari Imana kandi akaba
umuntu, n’abe ari ko dushobora gusangira ku kamere yiwe y’Imana.

Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Data wamaho, uyu musi wazanye umutwenzi kw’isi utumye
umumarayika. None turagusavye:
Duhe ubuzima, Mana nzima!
Wewe witoreye Bikira Mariya ngo abe Nyina w’Umukiza,
- rabana urukundo abarorereye ukubohoka kwabo.
Wewe watumye Gaburiyeli kumenyesha Mariya akanyamuneza
n’amahoro
- duhe kumenya ko Umwana wiwe ari We azoshitsa ivyo abantu
bizigiye.

Aho Mariya yakira ijambo ryawe, ububasha bwa Mutima bwaciye
bumutwikira, Jambo na we abana natwe:
- imitima yacu, nuyitegurire kumwakira.
Wewe wimika abicisha bugufi agahaza ivyiza abashonje,
- uyu musi turasabiye abatobato muri twebwe hamwe n’abafatwa nabi,
abashonje hamwe n’abahava basezera iyi si.
Iwawe nta kidashoboka, kandi ni wewe musa ukora ibitangaza,
- ku musi wa nyuma, uradushikana mu buzima budahera.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…
IGISABISHO
Uwukivuga navuge ca kindi co mu gitondo

Raba, mpagaze ku rugi nuguruza. Hagize uwumva ijwi ryanje akugurura
urugi, nzokwinjira iwe, mpeze mfungure hamwe na we, na we afungure
hamwe nanje. (Aleluya)!

Amatunga yo kw’isi yose ntiyoshobora kugura urukundo. (Aleluya)!

IGISABISHO

mpera wemereye abicisha bugufi.

ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.

AMAZABURI YO KU W’IMANA WA 1 WO MU GIHE GISANZWE
(urup. 486), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Yarasesanguye ubwitonzi bw’abakurambere yongera arategera ivyo
abahanuzi bavuze. Aleluya!
2. Ku bw’Inkuru nziza, Imana iduhamagarira kumenya ubuninahazwa bwa
Kristu. Aleluya!
3. Igihugu c’Imana kizoyihayagiza, kizokwibuka ijambo ryayo. Aleluya!

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Abanyakorenti 15, 1-2a. 3-4
Ndasubiye kubibutsa, benewacu, ya Nkuru nziza nabamenyesheje, ari
yo mwakiriye kandi mutsimbatayemwo, ni yo idahengeshanya kubakiza
muyigumije nk’uko nayibamenyesheje. Ubwa mbere ho, nabashikirije
ivyo nanje nashikirijwe, ko Kristu yapfuye kubera ibicumuro vyacu
nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse, kandi ko yabambwe, ko yazutse ku musi
ugira gatatu, nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse.
INYISHU
Inyigisho yabo irashika kw’isi yose,
n’Inkuru nziza ku mpera z’isi.

AMAZABURI YO MU MASHEMEZO RUSANGI Y’ABATUMWA,
BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Kubera ingabirano nahawe n’Imana, nashinzwe kuba umusuku w’Inkuru
nziza. Aleluya!
2. Ndi umusuku w’Inkuru nziza kugira ngo nze ntorane hamwe na Kristu.
Aleluya!
3. Jewe narahawe inema y’ukumenyesha abanyamahanga itunga rihebuje rya
Kristu. Aleluya!
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abanyakolosi 1, 3-6
Ntiduhengeshanya gukengurukira Imana, Se w’Umukama wacu Yezu
Kristu mu kubibuka mu bisabisho vyacu, kuko twumvise ukwemera
mufise muri Yezu Kristu n’urukundo mufitiye aberanda bose kubera
amizero mwabikiwe mw’ijuru, ayo mizero mwumvise kera muri rya
jambo ry’ukuri ry’Inkuru nziza, ryashikiye iwanyu nk’uko ryakwiye
kw’isi yose rikama kandi rigasagarara. N’iwanyu ni ko kw’uko, kuva
aho mwumviye mugategera ingabirano y’Imana mu kuri.

ubuninahazwa bw’Umukama. Aleluya, aleluya!

ubuninahazwa bw’Umukama. Aleluya, aleluya!

(urup. 1140), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Urahiriwe, Simoni mwene Yona, kuko Data yaguhishuriye ikinyegezwa ca
Kristu.
2. Uri Petero, kandi kuri uru rutare ni ho nzokwubaka Ekleziya yanje.

3. Ewe Pawulo, wewe Mutumwa wo mu makungu, uri igikoresho Imana
yitoreye kugira ngo umenyeshe ukuri kw’isi yose.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abanyaroma 1, 1-3a. 7
Jewe Pawulo, umusuku wa Kristu Yezu, nahamagariwe kuba
umutumwa, ntorerwa kwigisha Inkuru nziza y’Imana, yamenyesheje yo
nyene kuva kera iciye ku bahanuzi bayo mu Vyanditse vyeranda, ku
vyerekeye Umwana wayo. Bakunzi b’Imana namwe beranda mwese
mwatowe muri i Roma, nimugire umugisha n’amahoro bikomoka ku
Mana Dawe wa twese no ku Mukama Yezu Kristu.

Kristu.

Nibagire ic’ejo ku mugoroba

IGISABISHO

beranda nibadushigikire mu kutubera mu ngoro; maze, abo waciyeko
ngo ushikirize Ekleziya yawe intangamarara y’ivyiza vy’ijuru, ugume
ubacako ngo uyigabire intabaro z’urukiza rwamaho.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda,Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.

AMAZABURI YO KU MUSI W’IMANA WA 1 WO MU GIHE
GISANZWE (urup. 486), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:

ntiyampfuyeko ubusa.
3. Nararwanye indwano nziza, narangije urugendo, narazigamye ukwemera.

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Petero 4, 13-14

ngo no ku musi w’ihishurwa ry’ubuninahazwa bwiwe muze munezerwe
muhimbarwe. Nimwaba mutukwa kw’izina rya Kristu, murahiriwe,
kuko Mutima w’ubuninahazwa ari we Mutima w’Imana aba aruhukiye
muri mwebwe.

AMAZABURI YO MU MASHEMEZO RUSANGI Y’ABATUMWA
(urup. 1146), BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Simoni we! Nagusabiye kugira ngo ukwemera kwawe ntikugirire. Nawe
rero niwamara kwigarura, uraheza uremeshe benewanyu.
2. Nzokwishimagiza canecane mu magara make yanje, kugira ngo ubukomezi
bwa Kristu bugerere muri jewe.
3. Wewe mwungere w’ubusho ukaba na kizigenza mu batumwa, ni wewe
ufise impfunguruzo z’Ubwami bw’ijuru.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Abanyakorenti 15, 3-5. 8
Ubwa mbere ho, nabashikirije ivyo nanje nashikirijwe, ko Kristu
yapfuye kubera ibicumuro vyacu nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse, kandi ko
yabambwe, ko yazutse ku musi ugira gatatu, nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse,
ko yabonekeye Kefasi hanyuma bamwe icumi na babiri. Maze,
hanyuma ya bose, yarambonekeye nanje nari meze nk’uwavutse
atageze.

ubuninahazwa bw’Umukama.

ubuninahazwa bw’Umukama.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Kuri uyu musi mukuru w’Abatumwa Petero na Pawulo,
ari bo nkingi z’Ekleziya, turagusavye Yezu, Wewe Mwana w’Imana:
Mukama, nube kumwe n’igihugu cawe.
Simoni, umurovyi, wamugize umurovyi w’abantu,
- rungika rero abatumwa bashasha kugira ngo abantu benshi
bumve ijambo ryawe.
Uri mu kiyaga, warategetse umuyaga ngo utekane kugira ngo
ubwato bw’abigishwa bawe ntibutwarwe,
- nurinde rero Ekleziya yawe igihe iri mu bihuhusi wongere
ukomeze abo wayishinze.
Umaze kuzuka, abigishwa bawe wabegeranirije iruhande ya Petero,
- Wewe Mwungere mwiza, niwegeranye igihugu cawe kigire ubusho
bumwe.
Wewe warungitse umutumwa wawe Pawulo kumenyesha
abanyamahanga Inkuru nziza,
- gira ko ijambo ryawe ryoshikira ibiremwa vyose.
Wewe wasigaranye Ekleziya yawe impfunguruzo z’Ubwami,
- niwugururire amarembo y’ijuru abantu bose
bemeye urukundo rw’igishika ubafitiye.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…
IGISABISHO
Uwukivuga navuge ca kindi co mu gitondo

Nidukengurukire Imana Data,
Yo yaduhaye amagara y’ugusangira
mu muco wayo uhimbaye
iragi ry’aberanda.
Ni We yadukuye mu bubasha bw’umuzimagiza,
adushira mu Bwami bw’Umwana wiwe akunda cane,
We twaronsemwo urukiza
n’ikigongwe c’ibicumuro.

Ni we gashusho k’Imana itaboneka,
ni we yaboneye izuba zina kiremwa cose;
kuko muri we ari ho vyose vyaremewe,
ivyo mw’ijuru n’ivyo kw’isi.
Vyose ni we yabiremye, abirema avyiremera,
ibiboneka n’ibitaboneka;
yamye ariho vyose bitarahaba,
kandi vyose bibeshwaho muri We.
Ni we kandi Mutwe w’Umubiri wiwe Ekleziya,
ni We Mfura y’abapfuye,
ni We yagenywe kuba
uwa mbere muri vyose.
Ugasangwa Imana yashimye
ko vyose bisagarara muri Kristu,
kandi yashatse ko aba
Sahwanya wa vyose.
Aho yasesa amaraso yiwe ku musaraba,
Imana yashatse kwuzura
n’ibiremwa vyayo vy’isi
n’ibiremwa vyayo vy’ijuru.
Nabonye Umwagazi uhagaze usa n’uwishwe,
numva ijwi ry’abamarayika benshi bakikije ya ntebe y’Imana.

AMAZABURI YO KU MUSI W’IMANA WA 1 WO MU GIHE

AMAZABURI
Izaburi ya 33 (34). Umukama ni we bukiriro bw’intungane
Muramaze kwinovora ko Umukama ari mwiza (1 Petero 2, 3)
I
Umumarayika w’Umukama acumbitse
iruhande y’abamwubaha, kugira ngo abakize.
Nzoninahaza Umukama igihe cose,
ishimagizwa ryiwe ntirizomva mu kanwa.
Umutima wanje wihayagiza mu Mukama,
abicisha bugufi nibumve bahimbarwe.
Nimuninahaze Umukama hamwe nanje,
duhayagize twese hamwe izina ryiwe.
Nararondeye Umukama aranyishura,
ankiza ubwoba bwanje bwose.
Abamuravye barashwashwanuka,
ntibijirwa mu maso habo.
Hari umurushwa yatabaje, Umukama arumva,
amukiza amaganya yiwe yose.
Umumarayika w’Umukama acumbitse
iruhande y’abamwubaha kugira ngo abakize.
Umvirize kandi murabe ukuntu Umukama ari mwiza,
hahiriwe umuntu amuhungirako.
Nimwubahe Umukama, se mwa beranda biwe,
kuko abamwubaha ata co bakena.
Abatunzi barakena bagasonza,
ariko abarondera Umukama nta ciza na kimwe babura.
Umumarayika w’Umukama acumbitse
iruhande y’abamwubaha, kugira ngo abakize.

II
Umukama naninahazwe: umumarayika wiwe yarandinze.
Nimuze bane, munyumvirize,
ndabigishe kwubaha Umukama.
Mbega ni uwuhe muntu yipfuza kuramba,
akunda imisi abonamwo ubuhirwe?
Urarinda ururimi rwawe akabi,
umunwa wawe na wo uzire ikinyoma.
Urahunga ikibi ukore iciza,
urondere amahoro, ugume uyaharanira.
Umukama yamiza amaso ku bantu b’intungane,
agatega amatwi amaborogo yabo.
Umukama yama arerekesha ijisho abakora ikibi,
kugira ngo azimanganye kw’isi icotuma babibuka.
Intungane ziratabaza Umukama akumva,
akazikiza amaganya yazo yose.
Umukama yama hafi y’abo umutima watuntuye,
agakiza abo umutima washegeshwe.
Amarushwa menshi arashikira intungane,
ariko Umukama akayamukiza yose.
Amuzigamira amagufa yiwe yose,
nta na rimwe muri yo rivunika.
Umubisha azokwicwa n’ikibi,
abanka intungane na bo bazohanwa.
Umukama ararokora ubuzima bw’abasavyi biwe,
nta wuhanwa mu bamuhungirako bose.
Umukama naninahazwe: umumarayika wiwe yarandinze.

Ururirimbo. Ivyahishuwe 11-12. Urubanza rw’Imana.
Nimuninahaze Imana y’ijuru,
nimuyishimagize imbere y’ibiriho vyose:
nkako yarabagiriye ubuntu.
Turagukengurukiye, Mana yacu,
Mukama, wewe uganza vyose,
Wewe uriho, kandi wamyeho;
kuko wakiriye ububasha bwawe bw’agahambaye,
ugashinga ubwami bwawe.
Amahanga yari yashavuye,
haza rero ishavu ryawe
n’igihe co gucira urubanza abapfuye,
igihe co guhera abasuku bawe, abahanuzi n’aberanda,
bo n’abubaha izina ryawe, abato n’abakuru.
Ubwami n’intsinzi n’ububasha
birashikira ubu Imana yacu,
be n’inganji y’Intumwa yayo Kristu;
kuko umwe yahora arega benewacu yakorokeye hasi,
urya nyene yaguma abarega imbere y’Imana yacu, ijoro n’umutaga.
Na bo nyene baramutsindishije amaraso y’Umwagazi,
be n’intahe y’agakura bamushingiye:
ntibigunganye ubuzima bwabo, ariko baramupfiriye.
Himbarwe rero, wewe juru,
namwe abaribamwo mwese.
Nimuninahaze Imana y’ijuru,
nimuyishimagize imbere y’ibiriho vyose:
nkako yarabagiriye ubuntu.

ukadugana na vya bisabisho vy’aberanda mu maso y’Imana.

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 1 Abanyakorenti 15, 1-2a. 3-4
Ndasubiye kubibutsa, benewacu, ya Nkuru nziza nabamenyesheje, ari
yo mwakiriye kandi mutsimbatayemwo, ni yo idahengeshanya kubakiza
muyigumije nk’uko nayibamenyesheje. Ubwa mbere ho, nabashikirije
ivyo nanje nashikirijwe, ko Kristu yapfuye kubera ibicumuro vyacu
nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse, kandi ko yabambwe, ko yazutse ku musi
ugira gatatu, nk’uko biri mu Vyanditse.

AMAZABURI YO MU MASHEMEZO RUSANGI Y’ABATUMWA,
BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Kubera ingabirano nahawe n’Imana, nashinzwe kuba umusuku w’Inkuru
nziza.
2. Ndi umusuku w’Inkuru nziza kugira ngo nze ntorane hamwe na Kristu.
3. Jewe narahawe inema y’ukumenyesha abanyamahanga itunga rihebuje rya
Kristu.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abanyefezi 4, 11-13
Kristu ni we yahaye bamwe kuba abatumwa, abandi abahanuzi, abandi
abakwiza Inkuru nziza, abandi abungere n’abigisha, kugira ngo
aberanda babone gutungana mu gikorwa c’ugukoreranira mu kwubaka
umubiri wa Kristu gushika aho twese hamwe tuzoshikira ubumwe
bw’ukwemera n’ubw’ukumenya Umwana w’Imana, tugashikira wa
muntu abushitse, ku rugero rw’igihagararo kizima c’umusesekara wa

AMAZABURI YO KU WA 14 NYAKANGA (urup. 1016),
BAKORESHEJE IBI BITERO:
1. Nabonye isinzi ryinshi ry’abantu ata n’umwe yoshobora guharura bava mu
makungu yose, bahagaze imbere y’intebe y’Imana.
2. Imana yarabagejeje isanga baraberanye na yo, ni co gituma yabahaye
ubuninahazwa mu bwami bwayo.
3. Mukama Yezu, waraducunguye mu maraso yawe, ucungura abantu bo mu
miryango yose, mu ndimi zose, mu bihugu vyose no mu makungu yose,
utugirira Imana yacu ubwami bw’abasaserdoti.
IJAMBO RY’IMANA. 2 Abanyakorenti 6, 16b; 7, 1
Nkako mwebwe muri isengero y’Imana nzima, nk’uko Imana yabivuze
iti: «Nzogerera muri bo, ngendere hagati yabo, kandi nzobabera Imana
na bo bambere igihugu». Ko dufise iyo mihango, bakunzi banje,
nitwityorore rero ubuhumane bwose bw’umubiri n’ubw’umutima,
tubandanye kwigira beranda n’icubahiro dufitiye Imana.

1. Ntiwatinye umuruho uva ku bikorwa, urupfu ntirwagutsinze. Ntiwatinye
n’ugupfa, kandi n’ubuzima ntiwabwanse.
2. Mukama, igihugu cawe nicaba kikinkeneye, sinanse gukora. Ishaka ryawe
niriranguke.
3. Martino yarasezeye iyi si; ni muzima kumwe na Kristu: akayanganira mu
basaserdoti b’Umukama.

URURIRIMBO RWA BIKIRA MARIYA
Urahiriwe Martino! Warakunze Umwami w’ijuru ntiwatinya abatware
b’iyi si! Warambitswe urugori rw’abatsinze!
IGISABISHO
Uwukivuga navuge ca kindi co mu gitondo

- nutugire ivyabona vy’Izuka ryiwe.

- duhe natwe tumenyeshe Inkuru nziza.
Wewe warungitse Umwana wawe kubiba imbuto y’Ijambo ryawe,
- rungika abakozi mu murima wawe.
Wewe warungitse Umwana wawe kugusubiriza hamwe n’isi ku
bw’amaraso yiwe,
- tugire ibikoresho bizima bishikiriza amahoro yawe.
Wewe wicaritse Umwana wawe iburyo bwawe mw’ijuru,
- akira abacu bamaze gusezera iyi si mu kanyamuneza k’Ubwami
bw’ijuru.

n’ishusho y’Umwana wayo. Abo yigeneye ni bo kandi yatoye, na bo
abo yatoye ni bo kandi yagize intungane.

mu y’Abayobozi (urup. 1169)
IGISABISHO
Mukama, warahaye Toma mweranda yagupfiriye umutima w’ubutwari
watumye atanga ubuzima bwiwe ku bw’ubutungane; ku bw’igisabisho
ciwe rero, nudufashe guheba ubuzima bwacu ku bwa Kristu tukiri hano
kw’isi, kugira ngo dushobore kubukomorerwa mw’ijuru.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Umuhezagiro.

Izaburi y’146. Ugushemeza Imana itanga ubuzima
Mu marembo ya Yeruzalemu hazosamirana
indirimbo z’akanyamuneza, mu nzu zaho zose bavuge bati:
«Aleluya! Imana y’Israyeli iragashimagizwa!»
Mu gihe c’Ikarema

«Urakaninahazwa!»
Shemeze Umukama:
birahimbaye kuririmbira Imana yacu,
biraryoshe kumushimagiza.
Umukama ni we yubaka Yeruzalemu,

akoraniriza hamwe abana b’Israyeli, bari bangajwe;
ni we akiza abo agatima gashegeshwe,
agakanda inguma zabo;
ni we aharura igitigiri c’inyenyeri,
imwimwe akayita izina ryayo.
Umukama Mushoboravyose ni agahambaye,
ubwenge bwiwe ntibugira ingero.
Umukama ahagarikira abatobato,
inkozi z’ikibi na zo akazicinyiriza hasi.
Muririmbire Umukama mumukengurukira,
mucurarangire Imana yacu mu murya w’inanga.
Ijuru ni we arikwiza ibicu,
akaronderera imvura isi;
ni we ameza ubwatsi ku mitumba,
akaronderera imirima abantu;
ni we agaburira utwokurya ibitungwa,
be n’ivyana vy’ibikona nyene.
Ntiyishimira ubukomezi bw’ifarasi,
kandi ntiyizigira intege z’abantu.
Umukama ahimbarwa n’abamwubaha,
be n’abizera ikigongwe ciwe.

Izaburi y’147. Amashemezo ya Yeruzalemu nshasha
Imana yarakomeje ibihindizo vy’irembo ryawe,
iguhezagirira abana bawe mu rugo rwawe (Aleluya)!
Yeruzalemu, igine Umukama,
nawe Siyoni, shemeza Imana yawe!
Ni we yashimangiye ibikingi vy’ibirimba vyawe,
akaguhezagirira abana bawe;
ni we atekanya imbibe zawe,
akaguhimbisha akanovera k’ingano.
Ni we arungika ijambo ryiwe kw’isi,
rigaheza rikagenda rinyaruka;
ni we ayonza urubura nk’ubwoya bw’intama,
agakunkumura amarekano y’amabi nk’umunyota.
Ni we aca amasare y’urubura ubunywenywe,
urukanya rwayo ni nde yorukira?
Avuga rimwe, maze rugaca rushonga,
yarungika umuyaga wiwe, amazi agatemba.
Ni we yamenyesheje Yakobo ijambo ryiwe,
agashikiriza Israyeli amabwirizwa yiwe n’ingingo ziwe.
Nta kindi gihugu na kimwe yagiriye ben’uko,
nta kindi gihugu na kimwe camenye ingingo ziwe.
Imana yarakomeje ibihindizo vy’irembo ryawe,
iguhezagirira abana bawe mu rugo rwawe (Aleluya)!

Ururirimbo. Abanyakolosi 1, 12-20
Mukama, urakaninahazwa muri Ekleziya, ku bwa Kristu!
Nidukengurukire Imana Data,
Yo yaduhaye amagara y’ugusangira

mu muco wayo uhimbaye
iragi ry’aberanda.
Ni We yadukuye mu bubasha bw’umuzimagiza,
adushira mu Bwami bw’Umwana wiwe akunda cane,
We twaronsemwo urukiza
n’ikigongwe c’ibicumuro.
Ni we gashusho k’Imana itaboneka,
ni we yaboneye izuba zina kiremwa cose;
kuko muri we ari ho vyose vyaremewe,
ivyo mw’ijuru n’ivyo kw’isi.
Vyose ni we yabiremye, abirema avyiremera,
ibiboneka n’ibitaboneka;
yamye ariho vyose bitarahaba,
kandi vyose bibeshwaho muri We.
Ni we kandi Mutwe w’Umubiri wiwe Ekleziya,
ni We Mfura y’abapfuye,
ni We yagenywe kuba
uwa mbere muri vyose.
Ugasangwa Imana yashimye
ko vyose bisagarara muri Kristu,
kandi yashatse ko aba
Sahwanya wa vyose.
Aho yasesa amaraso yiwe ku musaraba,
Imana yashatse kwuzura
n’ibiremwa vyayo vy’isi
n’ibiremwa vyayo vy’ijuru.
Mukama, urakaninahazwa muri Ekleziya, ku bwa Kristu!

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Ivyahishuwe 21, 2-3. 22. 27
Mbona igisagara ceranda, Yeruzalemu nshasha, ndakibona kiriko
kirururuka kiva mw’ijuru kwa Mana, citoye nk’umugeni yitoreye
umunega wiwe. Numva kandi ijwi rirenga rivuye kuri ya ntebe rivuga
riti: «Ng’iri ihêmá ry’Imana n’abantu! Imana izobana na bo, bazoba
ubwabo igisata cayo, na yo ubwayo izoba Imana kumwe na bo.»
Bisubiye kandi, nta sengero nabonye muri ico gisagara, kuko Umukama
Imana Mushoboravyose hamwe na wa Mwagazi ari bo sengero ryaco.
Kandi muri co, nta gihumanye kandi nta n’uwukora amashano Canke
abesha, atari abanditswe mu gitabu c’ubuzima c’Umwagazi.

ni yo izokubera umuco na ntaryo.

abana b’Imana bose bashwiragiye, uyu musi tuje gusabira Ekleziya
yawe yafutanijwe n’amacakubiri yacu:

- nuyihe kuguma ari intayegayega mu kwemera, ishobore kumenyesha
izina ryawe.

n’amazi,
- nunagure Ekleziya yawe ku bw’iriba ry’ibatisimu no ku bw’ikalisi
y’ubukiriro.
Wewe watwemereye ko uzokwama uri hagati y’abakoranye kw’izina
ryawe,
- niwumvire igisabisho c’umuryango wawe.
Abagukunda, ushima kubagira ingoro yawe:
- Ese Mutima w’urukundo yoba ari we akuza Ekleziya yawe!

Ewe Yezu, Mwana wa Mariya, twumvire!
Ewe Zuba ry’ubutungane, Umubikira yaje imbere yawe
nk’uko umutwenzi uza imbere y’umurango:
- duhe tugendere mu muco wawe.
Ewe Jambo wamaho, wewe witoreye Umubikira atagira akanenge
ngo akubere umuvyeyi,
- dukure mu ngoyi z’igicumuro.
Ewe Mukiza wacu, wewe washatse ko Mariya
agukurikira mu nzira y’i Gologota,
- duhe twizigire kuzoronka akanyamuneza k’Ipasika.
Mwana w’ikinege w’Imana, igihe witanga ku musaraba,
waduhaye Mariya ngo atubere umuvyeyi:
- uramwūmvira igihe cose adusabira.
Canke:

twongere tumubwire turi kumwe na we tuti:
Umutima wacu uraninahaza Umukama.
Mwana w’Imana nzima, ku bw’ukubabara kwawe, warakingiye nyoko
agatosi kose:

- dukingire igicumuro.

- tugire ingoro ya Mutima Mweranda.
Wewe ugaba ubwenge bwose, amajambo yawe n’ibikorwa vyawe
vyaguma vyinjira mu mutima wa nyoko:
- twigishe rero kuzigama ijambo ryawe mu mitima yacu.
Mukiza w’isi, warashatse ko Mariya aba hafi y’umusaraba:
- igihe turi mu mageragezwa, uraduha ubukomezi.
Ewe Yezu wazutse, wewe wicaye iburyo bwa Data, waraninahaje
Mariya ku bw’umutima no ku bw’umubiri wiwe:
- tumbereza ivyipfuzo vyacu ku vyiza vy’ijuru.

twokoresha mu kugushimagiza, wewe waduhaye Umucunguzi, ari we Yezu
Kristu, Umukiza wacu?

cawe, ni wewe cubahiro c’Ekleziya yose!

IJAMBO RY’IMANA. Abanyaroma 8, 35.37-39
Ni nde azodukura ku rukundo rwa Kristu? Mbega, ni amarushwa, canke
ni amaganya, canke ni uruhamo, canke ni inzara, canke ni ukubura ico
twambara, canke ni amakuba, canke ni inkota? Ariko muri ivyo vyose,
turatsinda kubera uwadukunze. Nkako, ndemera ntakekereza ko ata
rupfu canke ubuzima, ata bamarayika canke inganji, ata n’ibiriho canke
ibizoza, ata bifise ububasha, ata biri mu kirere canke ibwina, ata
n’ikiremwa na kimwe kizoshobora kudukura ku rukundo rw’Imana
rwamenyeshejwe muri Kristu Yezu Umukama wacu.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Túri kumwe n’abamaratiri, bo bahevye ubuzima bwabo ku bw’Ijambo
ry’Imana, nimuze dushimagize Umukiza wacu, We cabona
c’intahemuka, mu kuvuga tuti:
Turagushemeza, Mwami w’ubuninahazwa!
Ku bw’abamaratiri bemeye gupfa kugira ngo bagaragaze ukwemera,
- duhe umutima widegemvya.
Ku bw’abamaratiri bemeye ko amaraso yabo aseseka kugira ngo
bemeze izina ryawe,
- duhe ubukomezi mu kwemera.
Ku bw’abamaratiri bagukurikiye mu nzira y’umusaraba,
- dukomeze igihe turi mu mageragezwa.
Ku bw’abamaratiri bameshe amakanzu yabo mu maraso y’Umwagazi,
- duhe dutsinde inyosha mbi zo kuri iyi si.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese...

IGISABISHO
Iyo ata gisabisho cerekeye uwo mu maratiri canke abo bamaratiri
categekanijwe:
Ari benshi atari mu gihe c’Ipasika
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi wamaho, Wewe wahaye aberanda N. na
N. kubabara ku bwa Kristu, nudufashe natwe mu magara make dufise;
maze, nk’uko aba beranda batatinye gupfa ku bwawe, abe ari ko
twamana ubutwari mu kwemeza izina ryawe.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Canke:
Turakuzamvye Mukama, aberanda N. na N. bagupfiriye
nibakudushikirize mu kutubera mu ngoro, bongere badushigikire ngo
twemeze ukuri kwawe.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Ari benshi, mu gihe c’Ipasika
Mana Mushoboravyose, turabikuzamvye: ubukomezi bwa Mutima
Mweranda nibutugire imbangutsi mu kwemera n’intatsindwa mu
kukugaragaza, kuko ari Wewe wahaye aberanda N. na N. bagupfiriye
inema yo guheba ubuzima bwabo kubera ijambo ryawe no kubera
intahe bashingiye Yezu.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.

Ari umwe, atari mu gihe c’Ipasika
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi Munyakigongwe, Wewe wahaye N.
yagupfiriye inema y’ubutwari mu magorwa y’ukubabara kwiwe,
turakuzamvye, twebwe turiko turahimbaza umusi w’intsinzi yiwe:
nudukingire, kugira ngo tube intatsindwa ntitugwe mu mitego
y’umwansi.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Canke:
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi wamaho, warahaye N. mweranda inema
yo kurwanira ubutungane gishika abupfire; natubere rero mu ngoro,
maze adufashe kurinda ku bw’urukundo rwawe ibiduhanamiye vyose,
twihutire gushika iwawe n’umutima wacu wose, kuko ari Wewe musa
Nyenubuzima.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Ari umwe, mu gihe c’Ipasika
Mukama, kugira ngo uboneshereze Ekleziya yawe, warateye N.
mweranda iteka ryo kugupfira; nutugirire rero imbabazi, maze, nk’uko
uwo yiganye ukubabara kw’Umukama, abe ari ko udufasha kujana
inzira yaciyemwo, tuberwe n’ugushikira ubuhirwe budahera.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Ari umubikira yapfiriye Imana
Mukama, uraduhaye uyu musi akanyamuneza k’ukwibuka N.
mweranda; nutugirire impuhwe, udutabare ku bw’ishimwe ryiwe, ngo
tubonesherezwe n’akarorero yaduhaye ku bwerentegerwa n’ubutwari.

Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Ari umukenyezi yapfiriye Imana
Mukama, Wewe utuma ubukomezi bwibonekeza mu magara make,
nutabare abo bose baje gushemeza ubuninahazwa bwa N. mweranda;
maze, uwahawe na Wewe umutima rugabo ngo aronke intsinzi
adusabire kuri Wewe imisi yose inema yo gutsinda natwe.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Umuhezagiro.

uyobowe n’Inkuru nziza,

n’ic’abayobozi beranda witoreye,
- tyorora muri iki gihe Ekleziya ku bw’igisabisho cabo.

ku bwa Mutima wawe,
- nuhe uwo Mutima nyene abungere b’Ekleziya yawe.

- none ntiwemere ko hagira umuntu n’umwe mu bo wakijije
yoguma ari kure yawe.

wabushinze,
- ntiwemere ko hagira umuntu n’umwe mu bamaze gusezera iyi si
yotakara;
ko witanze ku bwabo, nubakize.

Iyo ari umupâpá
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi wamaho, warashatse ko N. mweranda
arongora igihugu cawe cose akakigirira akamaro mu mvugo no mu
ngiro; ku bw’igisabisho ciwe rero, nuzigame abayobozi b’Ekleziya
yawe hamwe n’abo bashinzwe bose wongere uberekeze mu nzira
y’ubukiriro bwamaho.

mu myaka n’imyaka.
Iyo ari umwepiskopi
Mukama, warinjije mu muhari w’abepiskopi beranda N. mweranda yari
yuzuye urukundo agufitiye akaba rurangiranwa muri kwa kwemera
gutsinda isi; turakuzamvye rero, ku bw’igisabisho ciwe, udufashe
gutera imbere mu kwemera no mu rukundo, kugira ngo tuberwe
n’ugusangira na we ubuninahazwa.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Iyo ari uwashinze Ekleziya
Mukama, kubera (Umwepiskopi) N. mweranda yaje kubigisha, ba
sokuru warabahamagariye mu muco w’agatangaza w’Inkuru nziza;
nudufashe rero, ku bw’igisabisho ciwe, dutere imbere mu nema no mu
bumenyi bw’Umwana wawe, ari We Mukama wacu Yezu Kristu:
We musangiye ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda,
Imana imwe, mu myaka n’imyaka.

Iyo ari umuyobozi
Mukama, Wewe muco w’abakwemera ukaba uri n’umuyobozi
w’imitima, warashinze muri Ekleziya (Umwepiskopi) N. mweranda,
kugira ngo aragire intama zawe mu nyigisho kandi azibere akarorero;
nudufashe rero, ku bw’igisabisho ciwe, tuzigame kwa kwemera
yatwigishije twongere dukurikire ya nzira yatweretse mu kutubera
akarorero.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Iyo ari abayobozi benshi
Mukama, Wewe wahaye (Abepiskopi) N. na N. beranda umutima
wuzuye ukuri n’urukundo kugira ngo batunganirize igihugu cawe,
nudufashe natwe turiko turahimbaza umusi mukuru wabo, tugume
dutera imbere mu kubigana, twongere turemeshwe n’uko batubera mu
ngoro.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Iyo ari awamenyesheje Inkuru nziza
Mukama, wararungitse (Umwepiskopi) N. mweranda mu ntara
z’abapagani, kugira ngo abakure mu mwijima abimurire mu muco
w’ukuri; nudufashe rero, ku bw’igisabisho ciwe, tuzigame ibanga
ry’ukwemera tutayegayega twongere tugume tugenzwa n’ukwizigira
dukura ku Njili yatwigishije.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.

Ngirira ikigongwe, Mana yanje, kubera ubuntu bwawe,
ku bw’imbabazi zawe nyinshi, zimanganya ivyaha vyanje.
Nyuhagira umwanda wose mfise,
uheze uhanagure ibicumuro vyanje vyose.
Emwe simpakana ububegito bw’umutima wanje,
kuko ibicumuro vyanje vyose vyama binyagiriza.
Ni wewe musa nacumuyeko,
kandi nabikugiriye mu maso;
urubanza uciye ruraroranye,
ntaho wigera uca urwa ngondagonde.
Erega navukiye mu gicumuro,
na mawe yarakinsamanye;
weho wikundira intonganuke y’umushaha,
ni co gituma unshiramwo ubutungane ngo bunyure.
Ntotesha amazi y’umusarara, nce nkira umwanda wose,
unyuhagire nce ndusha inyange kwera de.
Nyumvisha ijambo ryompumuriza n’iry’urweze,
amagufa wari wajanjaguye ace yiyubura.
Ibicumuro vyanje vyose, vyikure mu maso,
n’ibibi vyanje vyose ubinzimanganirize.

ugushaka kwanje na kwo, ukuremeshe,
kwame kukwihambiriyeko.

Mukama, nzogukengurukira ubudahengeshanya.
URURIRIMBO RWA ZAKARIYA
Jewe ndi izuka n’ubuzima, uwunyemeye n’aho yoba yapfuye azoba
muzima.
Mu gihe ca Pasika
Kristu yaratsinze urupfu, aleluya; abapfuye yarabahaye ubuzima, Aleluya!
IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Nimuze dusabe Mana Data Mushoboravyose, we yazuye Yezu
akamukura mu bapfuye kandi akaba ari we azoha ubuzima imibiri yacu
yagenewe gupfa, tumubwire tuti:
Mukama, tubesheho muri Kristu.
Data mweranda rwose, ku bw’ibatisimu twarahambanywe n’Umwana
wawe, hanyuma tuzukana na we:
- nuduhe kugendera ubuzima bushasha kugira ngo inyuma y’urupfu
rwacu tuzogume turi bazima hamwe na Kristu.
Wewe waduhaye umukate muzima umanutse uva mw’ijuru,
- gira ko twowuronkamwo ubuzima, twongere tuwuronkemwo izuka ku
musi w’imperuka.

Wewe warungikiye Umwana wawe umumarayika kugira ngo
amuremeshe igihe yari mu maganya,
- urakomeza umwizero wacu umusi tuzopfa.
Wewe wakuye mw’itanure ya misore itatu,
- nuremurure abacu bapfuye umuzigo w’ibicumuro vyabo.
Mana y’abazima n’abapfuye, wewe wazuye Yezu,
- nuzure abacu bapfuye, natwe uzotwicarike iruhande yiwe turi kumwe
na bo.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…
IGISABISHO
Iyo ari umwe
Mukama, Wewe buninahazwa bw’abemera ukaba n’ubuzima
bw’intungane, Umwana wawe yaraducunguye mu rupfu n’izuka ryiwe;
nugirire imbabazi rero umusavyi wawe (incoreke yawe) N., maze,
nk’uko yemeye ca kinyegezwa c’izuka ryacu, abe ari ko aronka
akanyamuneza k’ubuhirwe budahera.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Mu gihe c’Ipasika
Mana Mushoboravyose kandi Munyakigongwe, Umwana wawe
yarashatse kurinda urupfu rw’umubiri ku bwacu; kunda utabare rero
umusavyi wawe (incoreke yawe) N., umusangize intsinzi y’agatangaza
y’izuka ryiwe.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.

Amen.
Iyo ari benshi
Mukama, Umwana wawe w’ikinege amaze gutsinda urupfu,
waramuhaye kwinjira mu buninahazwa bw’ijuru; kunda utabare
abasavyi bawe N. na N., kugira ngo bamaze gutsinda rwa rupfu
ruturaririye twese, bashobore kwama bakubona uko uri, Wewe
wabaremye ukabacungura.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Iyo ari abavukanyi bacu, incuti n’abatugiriye neza
Mukama, Wewe ufise imbabazi ugashaka ko abantu bokira, turiko
turibuka urukundo udufitiye; maze, ku bw’igisabisho ca Mariya
Muhimbazwa yamye ari Umubikira no ku bw’ibisabisho vy’aberanda
bose, kunda utabare abavukanyi bacu, incuti n’abatugiriye neza bavuye
kuri iyi si, uheze ubasangize ubuhirwe budahera.
Ku bw’Umukama wacu Yezu Kristu, Umwana wawe, We musangiye
ubuzima n’ingoma mu bumwe bwa Mutima Mweranda, Imana imwe,
mu myaka n’imyaka.
Amen.
Umuhezagiro.

AMAZABURI
Izaburi y’120. Imana ni yo muvunyi w’Israyeli.
Umukama azokurinda akabi kose,
azorinda ubuzima bwawe!
Amaso yanje ndayerekeje ku matāba;
urukiza rwanje ruzova hehe?
Urukiza rwanje ndarukesha Umukama,
we yaremye ijuru n’isi.
Umukama ntazokureka ngo utirimuke,
Umuvunyi wawe ntazokwigera ahunikira.
Eka nyabuna, Umuvunyi w’Israyeli
ntasinzira kandi ntahunikira.
Umukama azoba umuvunyi wawe,
Umukama azogukingira ikibaba;
ku mutaga izuba ntirikunage,
mw’ijoro ukwezi ntikukugobeko.
Umukama azokurinda akabi kose,
azigame umutima wawe;
Umukama azokuzigama mu mazinduka no mu maruhuka,
ubu no mu myaka yose.
Umukama azokurinda akabi kose,
azorinda ubuzima bwawe!

Izaburi y’129. Ukwizera ikigongwe c’Imana
Mbega Mukama niwaraba ivyaha vyacu,
ni nde azoragama ga Mukama?
Ndagutakambiye, Mukama, ndi mu nyenga,
Mukama, ndagutabaza, nyumvira:
nuntege amatwi,
igisabisho canje kibashe kugushikira.
Mbega Mukama, niwaraba akabi kacu,
ni nde azorokoka?
Ariko ikigongwe kiva iwawe,
ni co gituma bakwubaha kandi bakakwizera.
Umutima wanje uriteze Umukama,
ijambo ryiwe ni ryo nizeye;
umutima wanje uriteze Umukama,
gusumvya abateramyi biteze umutwenzi.
Umuteramyi niyitege umutwenzi,
Israyeli na yo niyitege Umukama!
Kuko urukiza ruva ku Mukama,
benshi bakaba ari ho bakirira rwose;
ni We azobohora Israyeli,
akayikiza ibicumuro vyayo vyose.
Mbega Mukama niwaraba ivyaha vyacu,
ni nde azoragama ga Mukama?
Ururirimbo. Abanyafilipi 2, 6-11. Kristu ni we Musavyi w’Imana
Nk’uko Data azura abapfuye akababeshaho,
ni ko na Mwana atanga ubuzima.
Kristu Kristu Yezu, n’aho yamanye kamere k’Imana,
ntiyigeze yishira hejuru
ngo ni uko ari Imana.

Ariko yigize ubusa,
mu gusangira kamere y’abasuku,
mu kwigira umuntu asa n’abandi.
Yigenjeje nk’umuntu asanzwe,
yicisha bugufi, aragamburuka
gushika ku rupfu, no ku rupfu rwo ku musaraba.
Ni co catumye Imana imushira hejuru ya vyose,
imwita Izina nyaryo,
izina rirengeye amazina yose.
Kugira ngo kw’izina rya Yezu
bose bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi,
mw’ijuru, kw’isi no mu nyenga,
Kandi ururimi rwose ruvuge ruti:
«Yezu Kristu ni we Mukama,
ngo Se aninahazwe!»
Nk’uko Data azura abapfuye akababeshaho,
ni ko na Mwana atanga ubuzima.

IGISABISHO C’UMURYANGO W’ABAKRISTU
Nimuze dutakambire Umukama Yezu, we azohindura imibiri yacu
yagenewe gupfa akayishushanya n’umubiri wiwe uninahaye, tuti:
Uri ubuzima bwacu ukaba n’izuka ryacu.
Ewe Kristu, wewe Mwana w’Imana nzima, wewe wazuye umukunzi
wawe Lazaro,
- abo wacunguje amaraso yawe nubashikane kw’izuka.
Ewe Kristu, wewe muhoza w’abababaye, warahanaguye amasozi
y’abari babuze uwabo,
- nuremeshe uyu musi abagandaye.
Ewe Kristu, wewe watsinze urupfu, mu mubiri wawe warasambuye
ububasha bw’igicumuro,
- dukize urupfu, utubesheho hamwe nawe.
Ewe Kristu, wewe muco w’isi, warakijije impumyi,
- niwereke inyonga zawe abapfuye.
Niwibuke abatarakumenya kandi badafise ukwizigira,
- ubahe kwemera izuka ryawe n’ubuzima budahera.
Aho tuzosezerera iyi si yagenewe guhera,
- uratwinjiza mu buruhukiro bwawe buhoraho.
Ibindi bisabisho mvamutima
Dawe wa twese…

Umuhezagiro.
Amajambo yo gusozera
Aha ni ho mperehereje iki gikorwa nari natanguye co kurondera
Amashemezo y’Ekleziya. Nk’uko mwabibonye, nabaye ndakora ivyo
mu gitondo no ku mugoroba gusa. Ayandi mashemezo yo mu masaha
yo ku mutaga, hamwe na ya yandi bagira basoma ijambo ry’Imana
(Office des lectures), nzobikora hanyuma, Imana niyaba ikintije
ubuzima n’amagara vyo ngaha kw’isi, canke n’abandi bazobikora.
Nk’uko kandi nabivuze mu ntango, aha nisunze Igifaransa, n’aho
harimwo bimwebimwe nafatiye ku kilatini. Ubu rero, ngiye gusubira
kwicarira ibiva mu kilatini nk’uko nabibabwiye mu ntango. Turi
kumwe rero mu Mukama. N’abampezagirire mwese!
